`just ok` - Run formatting (ruff) and type checking (ty). Run before committing.
`just test` - Run tests. `just install` - Install as global tool.
`just download` - Download articles from top 5 econ journals. `just stats` - Show database statistics.
Use packaged CLI: `uv run econprior --help`, `uv run econprior download -h`, `uv run econprior fill`. Run scri
